ACTIVATED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local life_to_gain = 0 local numPlayer = MTG():GetNumberOfPlayers() for i = 0, (numPlayer-1) do local player = MTG():GetNthPlayer( i ) if player ~= nil then if (player:GetTeam() ~= EffectController():GetTeam()) then local lifeLost = player:LoseLife( 4 ) life_to_gain = life_to_gain+lifeLost end end end if life_to_gain> 0 then EffectController():GainLife(life_to_gain) end
